caret_rule: GitHub existence or a prose mention does not automatically confer a CAEPR presentation caret. The user-command ^ triggers the governed audit; a displayed Name^ requires explicit canonical identity resolution in the applicable CAEPR state. PD-DMA exact-file carets are a separate namespace.
pressure_rule: Maximum pressure means maximum source-specific documentary questions, preservation, traceability and accountability; it does not permit fabrication, harassment or conversion of allegations into findings.
deletion_safe_condition: A successor can reconstruct current baseline, searches, findings, registrations, interlinks, publication/live state, open work and next actions without the originating chat.
